mucositis_grade.assessment_guidance: Current assessment: Assess oral pain and ulceration, the ability to eat and drink, changes in diet and the interventions needed. Use the verified named oral-mucositis criterion in CTCAE v4.0; record the current grade separately from the worst previous episode and its recovery.

A broad non-haematological field does not supply one universal severity scale, and current recovery does not erase prior worst severity.
